dimensions.assessment: Affects small businesses owned by veterans, reservists, and military spouses, as well as federal administrative agencies.
dimensions.evidence: small business concerns owned and controlled by covered individuals

dimensions.assessment: Requires administrative reports and studies without creating new direct financial assistance or altering loan terms.

dimensions.assessment: Amends reporting requirements under the Small Business Act and mandates a specific GAO study.

importance_detail.rationale: This bill requires the Small Business Administration to report on a veterans interagency task force and directs the Government Accountability Office to study credit access for veteran and reservist small businesses.
